items.title: Albert Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: And John Lewis and I were talking about them playing the big — the band stuff, the full band stuff.

ctx.x: So by 1942 or 3, by 1955 they were talking about “cool.” You know what I mean? That’s a very short life. Although some people, now, got stuck in that, and they act like bop was day before yesterday. Like the guys — we hear that Dizzy Gillespie broke up at Lincoln Center last month, well early this month, this is still September, yeah? Yeah, earlier this month. It opened the season, and now people are acting as if that was yesterday. And John Lewis and I were talking about them playing the big — the band stuff,…
